stories.headline: Ousted BP chairman hits back at 'lies' about his behaviour
stories.summary: Albert  Manifold said no-one should be "allowed to hide behind anonymity" when commenting on his time at BP.

voices.student_north: Yaar BP ke chairman ko nikaal diya toh ab bol raha hai anonymity hide karke koi bhi kuch bhi bol sakta hai. Bhai, hamare college mein professor ko feedback dene jao toh naam likhna padta hai — phir flunk ho jaate ho. Tumhare liye anonymity luxury hai, inke liye problem.
voices.student_south: BP chairman ko nikala, ab bolra hai anonymity hide mat karo. Bro, tera professor jo assignment fail karta hai without feedback — ussi ki energy. Sab "anonymous feedback" dete hain, actual guts nahi hote face karke bolne ke. Corporate world mein bhi same scam.
voices.professional_north: Yaar ye BP wala chairman bhi humari tarah hai na — anonymous complaints mil gayi, seedha defensive ho gaya. Hamare office mein bhi yehi hota hai, koi feedback dedo to boss bolte "kaun likha hai?" Pehle apna naam likho, phir suno lecture. Isko bhi same problem — jab anonymity nikli to sab kuch jhooth bol gaya.
voices.professional_south: Bhai, BP chairman ko bhi same problem. Anonymous feedback chahiye toh apna boss bhi de dega — "your work is average, your attitude is worse, anonymously." Fir woh bhi bolega lies hain. At least BP mein severance package milega, humein toh appraisal letter hi milta hai.

stories.headline: Mint Explainer: Why India wants to go back to standard edible oil pack sizes
stories.summary: The government plans to bring back standard pack sizes for edible oils on complaints that similar-looking pouches with different quantities and prices were making value-for-money comparisons difficult for buyers. The move aims to improve transparency

voices.student_north: Bhai edible oil ka pack size standard ho jayega toh kya? Ghar mein tel ki kimat dekh kar hi dil tut jaata hai. Phir bhi shukar hai — placement tak toh ek baar oil khareednaa padega, uske baad toh sab kuch corporate ka tension hoga.
voices.student_south: Bhai oil wala pack dekh ke confusion hota hai to imagine kar placement ki cutoff dekh ke. "1 liter" likha hai par pehle se 800ml nikla. Same energy jab professor "passing marks 40" bolte hain par actually 60 chahiye. Government trying to fix what we've been doing since childhood—scamming ourselves.
voices.professional_north: Bhai, ye sab standard pack size ka drama kar rahe hain — jaise humara salary slip mein bhi standard likha ho, lekin bonus ka size har mahine badal jaata hai. Company ko transparency chahiye toh apna appraisal letter padha de — wahan bhi confusion chhupa hua hai.
voices.professional_south: Bhai, edible oil pack sizes standardize karne ki baat chal rahi hai — matlab buyers ko confusion nahi hoga. Par office mein toh HR ne already confuse kar rakha hai — same designation, different salaries, kisi ko pata nahi kaun kitna earn kar raha. Transparency tab chahiye na jab apna payslip dekhu?

stories.headline: What to expect from Q3 results of IndiGo, SpiceJet, Jet Airways
stories.summary: SpiceJet, IndiGo and Jet Airways will benefit from the reduction in ATF prices, but in the long run.Q3 is a seasonally strong period and that could help offset the impact of high crude oil prices and a weak rupee

voices.student_north: Bhai airline stocks upar jayenge Q3 mein. ATF sasta ho gaya toh unka profit margin badhega. Par hum toh placement se pehle hi broke hain — agar flight book karni padi interview ke liye toh loan lena padega. Atleast airlines ko toh kuch fayda hai, hume toh sirf debt relief chahiye.
voices.student_south: Bhai, airlines ka Q3 results aayega — ATF prices gire, profits badhenge. Meanwhile tera internship stipend same rahega. Airline stocks zyada, tera account mein zeros zyada. Teri future itni weak rupee jitni hi hai.
voices.professional_north: Bhai, airlines ko ATF sasta mil raha hai toh ticket bhi sasta hona chahiye na? Nahi, price same rahega. Q3 mein sirf rich log udenge, hum toh train mein hi baithenge. Jaise boss ke pass paise zyada ho gaye toh hamare kaam badhate hain, waise hi airlines ka logic hai.
voices.professional_south: Bhai, airlines ka ATF price kam hua toh unka profit badega. Hamare company ka? Kya badega? Ticket prices same rahenge, salary same rahenge. Inko "seasonally strong" bolte hain, humein bolte hain "financially weak" — apna season toh kabhi nahi aata.

stories.headline: Valve hikes Steam Deck prices by more than 40%, blaming rising costs
stories.summary: The gaming giant said the handheld had not changed but the rise reflected "the current state of component costs"

voices.student_north: Bhai Steam Deck 40% mehnga ho gaya. Component costs badh gaye matlab. Hamare placement ke baad jo first salary aayegi, wo already inflation kha jayegi. Gaming toh door ki baat hai — ek chai afford karni mushkil ho jayegi.
voices.student_south: Steam Deck price utha 40% bhai. "Component costs" blame kar rahe hain. Mera laptop already broke, ab gaming console tak afford nahi hoga. Result: assignments on phone, placement prep on YouTube, future on life support.
voices.professional_north: Bhai Steam Deck ka price 40% badh gaya aur kehte hain "component costs badh gaye." Hamare salary toh 2% badha aur boss bolte hain "inflation ke hisaab se adjust kar le." Gaming console wale toh honest hain — humara company component ka excuse daal ke layoffs kar deta hai.
voices.professional_south: Bhai, Valve bolta hai component costs badh gaye, toh Steam Deck 40% mehenga. Hamare boss ko bhi yeh excuse seekhna chahiye — "Sir, mere component costs badh gaye, isliye salary same rahegi but output 40% kam hoga." Dekh tera gaming hobby bhi abh luxury ban gaya, like promotion.

stories.summary: Serena Williams is in discussions about a potential return to competitive tennis at Queen's Club next month.

voices.student_north: Serena Williams wapas aa rahi hai tennis mein. Humara comeback toh placement ke baad hoga — aur woh bhi agar kisi ne call diya toh. Atleast uske paas trophies hain, humara toh resume ka hi comeback pending hai.
voices.student_south: Serena Williams comeback at 40+ age. Meanwhile our professor still thinks we're 16, treating us like freshers. Serena grinding comeback matches, we grinding assignment deadlines. She's returning to tennis — we're just trying to return to our beds. Age is just a number, but so are our CGPA marks.
voices.professional_north: Yaar Serena Williams comeback ka socha toh mujhe apna appraisal याद आ गया — dono hi saal bhar sona padta hai, phir ek din boss bolता hai "wapas aa jao, targets clear karne hain." Farak itna ki Serena ko atleast trophy milega, mujhe toh just "good performance" comment milega Excel sheet mein.

stories.headline: Iran says it targeted American base after fresh US strikes
stories.summary: The hostilities come during a fragile ceasefire between the US and Iran, and protracted negotiations to end the three-month war.

voices.student_north: Bhai, US aur Iran aag-paani kar rahe hain, aur hum yahan placement ke liye stress le rahe hain. Iska kya matlab — dollar strong rahega, inflation badhega, ya package kam ho jaega? Ceasefire itni fragile hai jitna humaara GPA. Ek aur missile aur consulting firms hiring freeze kar denge.
voices.student_south: Bhai Iran aur US fighting, ceasefire ka naam bhi bhool gaye. Itna volatile situation hai — tumhara internship letter bhi uncertain hai. At least global instability mein tumhara placement insecurity ka company hai. Misery loves company, no?
voices.professional_north: Bhai, Iran-US ke beech jo tension chal raha hai na — humara stock market bhi usi tarah jhooth bol raha hai. Ek din "ceasefire ho gaya" bolte hain, dusre din missiles udne lagte hain. Exactly jaisa humara appraisal cycle — ek mahina "sab theek hai," agla mahina "targets nahi mile, bonus cancel.
voices.professional_south: Iran aur America ladai kar rahe hain, ceasefire break ho gaya. Humara boss bhi same thing karta hai — Monday ko peace treaty, Wednesday ko missile launch. Fragile ceasefire bolte hain usko... humara appraisal season bhi waisa hi fragile hai.

stories.headline: Why Yamuna is now brownish narrow stream
stories.summary: In an alarming display of environmental decline, the Yamuna has retreated to a thin stream, allowing locals to stroll across its once-swelling banks. This yearly event, worsened by minimal water allocations from Haryana and extreme heat evaporation,

voices.student_north: Yamuna abhi itni narrow ho gaya ki locals walk kar rahe hain iske upar. Bhai, hamare placement season mein river itna kamzor hai — campus interview pool se zyada desperate lag raha hai. At least Yamuna ko next monsoon hope hai, hamein toh sirf internship ki hope hai.
voices.student_south: Bhai Yamuna itna narrow ho gaya ki ab locals usse walk karke cross kar rahe hain. Meanwhile hamare campus ke drainage nala abhi bhi full-flow mein behta hai. Pollution ka distribution itna unfair hai — river ko zero, hostel toilet ko infinity. Environmental justice ka matlab samajh aa gaya.
voices.professional_north: Yamuna itni sukh gayi ki ab paidal cross kar sakte ho. Hamare boss ko dekh — woh bhi itna dry ho gaya appraisal season mein, kuch nahi nikalta. Haryana se water nahi mil raha, boss se salary nahi mil rahi — dono hi allocation mein chuse hain humko.
voices.professional_south: Yamuna shrink ho gaya, ab nadi nahin nala ban gaya. Haryana paani rok raha hai, aur humara boss humse deadlines rok nahi raha. Ek cheez dry ho rahi hai, dusri cheez sirf dried fruit ban gaya — aur wo dried fruit main hoon.

stories.headline: Paul McCartney on playing guitar with Paul Mescal: 'He knew it better than I did!'
stories.summary: The music legend on delivering "memory songs" for his 20th solo album, The Boys of Dungeon Lane - and why he's intrigued by the new Beatles biopics.

voices.student_north: Yaar Paul McCartney ne guitar sikhaya ek actor se. Ek legend ne apne aap ko humble kiya publicly. Aur hum yahan assignments mein copy paste kar rahe hain — kisi se seekhna toh dur ki baat hai. Ego itna bada hai ki profs se bhi galat answer suno toh argue kar dete hain.
voices.student_south: Paul McCartney guitar lesson from Paul Mescal. Legend getting schooled by an actor. Bhai, even the GOAT is admitting he doesn't know his own instrument. Meanwhile, you're struggling with one DSA problem for 3 hours. At least McCartney has an excuse — he's 82. What's yours?
voices.professional_north: Yaar Paul McCartney 80 saal ka aur abhi bhi kaam kar raha hai. Humara boss 45 ka hai aur retirement ka sapna dekh raha hai — tab tak hum retirement dekh rahe hain. Ek toh tera album chalega, dusra tera EMI bhi chalegi.
voices.professional_south: Yaar, Paul McCartney ne kaha guitar Paul Mescal se better khel sakta hai. Mera boss bhi aisa hi bolata hai — "Tumhara junior better code likhta hai." Fir appraisal time mujhe hi scolding deta hai. Legend hone ke baad bhi ego hurt hota hai, toh mera kya hi scene hai?
